messages.content: I can help with that. First, ensure it's plugged in and the charging light is on. If it is, hold the power button for 15 seconds to perform a hard reset.
How do I reset my portal password?
To reset your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. We will send a secure 6-digit OTP to your registered email to verify your identity.
